articles.title: Parents throw son out of property for not taking care of them: Bombay High Court agrees
articles.summary: The Bombay High Court ordered a son to vacate two properties gifted by his parents due to his failure to care for them, leading to a breakdown of relations. The court upheld that the gift deed conditions were unmet, justifying the property revocation.

articles.title: Will UPI MDR add extra cost to your monthly SIPs? Plan type and investment mode matter, say experts

articles.title: International Youth Day: Fewer responsibilities, longer time — how Gen Z can harness their 20s for wealth creation

articles.title: Accidents during lunch at work covered under employment laws? Employee gets ₹7.86 lakh compensation after 16 years

articles.summary: The EPFO has introduced new waiting periods for final settlement and withdrawal benefits, while also allowing members to access a significant portion of their balance for specified needs. The government has clarified the rules and outlined measures to ease implementation.

articles.title: Large-, mid- or small caps: How missing just 5 of market's best days in 21 years could cost you lakhs

articles.title: Selling jointly owned property by NRI: How will capital gains be taxed?
